Fixes from a full test of 1.8.7 on Linux with MiniMax.

## Fixes

- **Approvals show what Hermes enforces.** A bot set to Smart in Hermes no longer shows "Ask me".
- **Routines fire on time.** The app starts Hermes's scheduler without its idle shutdown and keeps it up while routines are live. Next times refresh, and the scheduler note is written for you.
- **Model switches apply on the next turn** in chats that are already open.
- **Memory tool is no longer reported as off.** Group replies no longer include onboarding text.
- **Save dialog** shows the file name, and the "saved" toast appears only after you save.
- **Attachment chips** for images, a **Stopped** marker after Stop, and no duplicate error when no provider is set (the model shows "Not set").
- **Linux:** window controls, a README section for running from source, no Windows-only token copy, and the This PC port is kept across restarts.
- **Secrets:** app keys are locked and marked, Hermes settings are folded away, and long names are truncated.
